description: Positive or negative sentiment of English text with a confidence score, from a DistilBERT model fine-tuned on SST-2. Use to triage reviews, support messages, social posts and replies. Example: text=The checkout was fast and support answered within minutes.. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
name: ai_sentiment
title: Sentiment of text
